title: A mutual friend, E, saw a rectangular craft
summary: Deep Prasad tells of A mutual friend, E, saw a rectangular craft, about an unknown time at an unknown place, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: we both have a mutual friend. I I'll call her E. Um, and uh, she's the only person I know who's ever seen a rectangular craft, by the way, which is super interesting.

plain: Deep Prasad, a researcher who claims artificial intelligence is alien technology, speaks of a mutual friend he calls only "E." He says she is the only person he knows who has seen a rectangular craft, which he finds unusual, though he gives no time or place.
